protocol_invariants.commit_authority: Strict exact-tree equality across every evaluated policy: a passing run may merge iff tested_tree == merged_mainline | members (zero commit-time oracle, zero escaped defects).
protocol_invariants.arrival_and_traces: Frozen v7 chronological merge traces (kubernetes/kubernetes, microsoft/TypeScript, vercel/next.js; 200 PRs each, 50 warm-up / 150 eval, zero omitted PRs, zero truncated files), rescaled to 6 PRs/hr baseline then velocity-multiplied (5x=30 PRs/hr nominal; 15x=90 PRs/hr saturated).
protocol_invariants.priors_and_leakage: Decoupled fixed generic scheduler priors (q0=0.10, p_c=0.10, p_persist=0.02, Beta(1,19) flake prior) and warm-up-only scales/graphs; zero access to ground-truth rates or evaluation labels.
protocol_invariants.uncertainty_protocol: 20 paired seeds (1001..1020) x 3 repos = 60 paired blocks per condition; 10,000 paired seed-block bootstrap resamples (Random(11629)) retaining equal repo weight plus exact two-sided sign test.
protocol_invariants.no_product_speed_claims: Every product-inspired baseline models documented public scheduling/failure semantics under shared fixed-capacity exact-tree simulation; results are NOT benchmarks of commercial hosted services (GitHub, Aviator, Trunk, Uber SubmitQueue, BMW internal CI).

included_baselines.mechanism: Unstacked cone-disjoint packing (unfiltered warm-up co-change + 2-level dir cliques), risk lanes, Beta-Binomial adaptive retry, 1-step blame.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Adaptive Beta-Binomial retry (<=2), then 1-step blame split, then bisection; stale-base passes re-queued.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: None (delegates directly to frozen v7 src/ssmq/simulator.py; verified identical to runs/v7_sim_main).

included_baselines.mechanism: Unstacked risk lanes (low-risk K<=8, high-risk K<=2), adaptive retry, 1-step blame; no cone exclusion.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Same as SSMQ without cone exclusion.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: None (delegates directly to frozen v7 src/ssmq/simulator.py).

included_baselines.mechanism: Unstacked FIFO batching (K<=8) with adaptive Beta-Binomial retry and bisection.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Adaptive retry, then recursive bisection; stale-base passes re-queued.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: None (delegates directly to frozen v7 src/ssmq/simulator.py).

included_baselines.primary_source: SSMQ v7 (frozen src/ssmq/simulator.py); multi-worker batch bisection control
included_baselines.mechanism: Unstacked multi-worker (W=8) FIFO batching (K<=8) with recursive bisection and no retry.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Recursive halving down to size 1; no retry; concurrent passes on stale mainlines re-queued.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: None (delegates directly to frozen v7 src/ssmq/simulator.py); serves as multi-worker control for Beheshtian-BatchStop4 and Bors-BatchBisect.

included_baselines.primary_source: Zuul Dependent Pipeline / GitLab Merge Trains abstraction (frozen src/ssmq/simulator.py)
included_baselines.mechanism: Single-timeline linear speculative prefix train (depth D<=4), one PR per stage.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Upstream failure cancels downstream stages and requeues; non-head prefix failures re-test isolated PR once before rejection.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: Single-repository queue without Zuul cross-repository Depends-On graphs.

included_baselines.primary_source: Uber SubmitQueue single-timeline abstraction (Ananthanarayanan et al., EuroSys 2019, DOI 10.1145/3302424.3303970)
included_baselines.mechanism: Single-timeline speculative outcome tree branching on pass/fail up to depth D<=4 with decoupled priors and expected-throughput batch sizing.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Pass advances to on_pass child (zero stale rechecks); fail discards on_pass and advances to bisected on_fail child.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: Single-timeline exact-tree abstraction only; omits Uber's closed distributed target conflict analyzer and multi-lane execution.

included_baselines.primary_source: Beheshtian, Bavand, & Rigby, 'Software Batch Testing to Save Build Test Resources and to Reduce Feedback Time', IEEE TSE 48(8):2784-2801, 2022 (DOI 10.1109/TSE.2021.3070269)
included_baselines.mechanism: FIFO batching (K<=8) with the public BatchStop4 failure-isolation cutoff: bisect while |B|>4, stop bisecting when |B|<=4 and test remaining PRs individually.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Failing batch of size 5..8 splits into two halves; failing batch of size 2..4 expands directly into singletons (no further halving); no retry; exact-tree stale rechecks under W=8.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: Adapted from offline post-commit Travis CI build-stream batching (static commit stream without moving merge base) to pre-merge W=8 exact-tree queue with K_max=8.

included_baselines.primary_source: Historical bors-ng documentation and README (github.com/bors-ng/bors-ng; bors.tech archived docs, hosted service deprecated May 2023)
included_baselines.mechanism: Single staging-branch FIFO batching (K<=8, 1 active staging batch at a time) with recursive depth-first bisection on failure.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Only one staging commit runs against mainline at a time (zero stale rechecks); failing batch bisects left then right sequentially on staging; failing singleton is kicked out; no retry.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: Models historical bors-ng single-staging-branch serialization inside the W=8 environment (inherently utilizes <=1 runner slot at a time); explicitly distinct from active rust-lang/bors manual/auto rollups.

included_baselines.primary_source: GitHub Docs, 'Managing a merge queue' (ALLGREEN grouping_strategy, gh-readonly-queue cumulative merge_group branches, max_entries_to_build)
included_baselines.mechanism: Single-timeline cumulative staged merge groups (main+P1, main+P1+P2, ...) up to max_entries_to_build = min(W, D) = 4.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: No bisection and no automatic retry: when head staged entry fails, that PR is evicted immediately and all downstream staged merge groups are destroyed/canceled and rebuilt atop mainline.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: Models ALLGREEN per-entry cumulative builds with cancel-in-progress=true and fixed max_entries_to_build=4 (matching max_spec_depth); abstracts away GitHub hosted runner elasticity, non-canceled orphaned runs, and HEADGREEN multi-PR masking.

included_baselines.primary_source: Jungwirth, Gruber, & Fraser, 'Predictive Pull Request Batching to Accelerate Merge Pipelines in Continuous Integration at Scale', IEEE ICST 2026 Industry Track, pp. 659-670 (DOI 10.1109/icst69053.2026.00087)
included_baselines.mechanism: Single-timeline exact-tree speculative merge pipeline (depth D<=4) grouping low-risk PRs (risk_score < 0.55) in ascending predicted risk order under a survival budget (>=0.55, K<=8) while isolating high-risk PRs as singletons.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Head pass merges batch with zero stale rechecks; head fail cancels downstream speculative stages, rejects singletons or bisects failing multi-PR batches at the head of the timeline; no retry.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: Explicitly scoped as PRediBatch-inspired: BMW's internal pipeline dataset, proprietary feature set, and trained ML classifier are closed/unavailable, and v7 traces lack historical CI pass/fail labels. Substitutes v7's leak-free warm-up metadata risk score and fixed generic prior (q0=0.10).

included_baselines.primary_source: Aviator MergeQueue 'Affected Targets' documentation (docs.aviator.co, non-Bazel directory-rule mode with Parallel Mode)
included_baselines.mechanism: Maps each PR directly to its 2-level directory targets (no warm-up co-change expansion) and routes target-disjoint PRs to parallel linear speculative lanes (depth D<=4 per lane) with bridge-PR barriers.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Held to equal strict exact-tree commit authority: cross-lane merges advance mainline and invalidate stale passing runs in other lanes (triggering stale rechecks and canceling that lane's speculative suffix); head failure evicts PR and cancels lane suffix.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: Uses 2-level directory prefixes (no Bazel build graph) and intentionally enforces strict global exact-tree commit authority rather than Aviator's production trust-target-isolation mode (which would relax exact-tree equality and risk cross-directory defect escapes).

included_baselines.primary_source: Batch 2 mechanism diagnostic addressing SSMQ v7 Sec. VII ('Cone explosion')
included_baselines.mechanism: Identical to SSMQ (unstacked cone-disjoint packing, risk lanes, adaptive retry, blame) except warm-up co-change graph drops mega-PRs (>20 files) and omits 2-level directory cliques.
included_baselines.failure_semantics: Identical to SSMQ; isolates mega-PR/directory-clique cone explosion from unstacked stale-base invalidation.
included_baselines.disclosed_deviations: Diagnostic ablation strictly constructed from warm-up PRs (zero evaluation leakage); paired against identical v7 GroundTruth.

omitted_baselines.baseline: Original PRediBatch trained ML classifier (BMW internal model)
omitted_baselines.reason_for_omission: BMW's industrial merge-pipeline dataset, internal feature schema, and trained ML model are proprietary and unavailable publicly. Moreover, the frozen v7 public traces contain merged PR metadata without historical CI pass/fail outcome labels required to train a supervised classifier.
omitted_baselines.what_would_be_needed: Multi-hundred-PR historical CI pass/fail labels per repository with leak-free chronological warm-up training.

omitted_baselines.baseline: Production Aviator / Trunk Affected Targets (trust-target-isolation / Bazel mode)
omitted_baselines.primary_source: Aviator MergeQueue Affected Targets docs (docs.aviator.co); Trunk Merge Queue impacted targets docs
omitted_baselines.reason_for_omission: Production trust-target-isolation merges disjoint-target lanes without cross-lane exact-tree re-verification. Granting that relaxation breaks equal exact tested-state commit authority and would permit cross-directory persistent conflicts to escape onto mainline unless a sound build dependency graph (e.g., Bazel/Buck target graph) is available, which frozen non-Bazel public traces lack.
omitted_baselines.what_would_be_needed: Sound build-system dependency graph and explicit escape-rate vs latency trade-off protocol outside exact-tree equality.

omitted_baselines.baseline: Production Uber SubmitQueue (multi-lane conflict-graph outcome trees / PerPRDAGRetry)
omitted_baselines.reason_for_omission: As established in v7 Sec. IV and VI, independent multi-lane outcome trees and partial-ancestor DAGs omit concurrent non-overlapping commits from their tested base, so they cannot commit independently under strict exact-tree authority without either an unrealizable commit-time oracle or cross-lane invalidation; Uber's closed target-level conflict analyzer is also unavailable.
omitted_baselines.what_would_be_needed: Sound target-level isolation oracle or explicit non-exact-tree relaxation.

omitted_baselines.baseline: Active rust-lang/bors (Homu successor with human/auto rollups)
omitted_baselines.primary_source: rust-lang/bors repository and Rust forge rollup policy
omitted_baselines.reason_for_omission: Active rust-lang/bors relies on reviewer-curated rollup priority labels (rollup=never/iffy/always) and dedicated auto/try branch workflows whose human triage decisions are absent from frozen v7 traces.
omitted_baselines.what_would_be_needed: Parsed rust-lang/rust bors comment logs, rollup membership records, and try/auto branch CI traces.

omitted_baselines.baseline: GitHub Merge Queue HEADGREEN mode & non-canceled orphaned runs / autoscaling runners
omitted_baselines.primary_source: GitHub Docs, 'Managing a merge queue' (HEADGREEN grouping_strategy & concurrency caveats)
omitted_baselines.reason_for_omission: HEADGREEN allows an earlier failing PR to merge if a later PR masks its failure, which is not represented by v7's monotonic culprit union model. Elastic hosted runner autoscaling would violate equal worker capacity (W=8). Non-canceled orphaned runs are a workflow misconfiguration rather than an algorithmic scheduling policy.
omitted_baselines.what_would_be_needed: Non-monotonic patch-masking fault model and explicit runner-elasticity cost model.

omitted_baselines.baseline: Beheshtian RiskBatch (supervised commit-risk ML) & Kamath LWD dynamic batching (EMSE 2025)
omitted_baselines.primary_source: Beheshtian et al., IEEE TSE 2022 (DOI 10.1109/TSE.2021.3070269); Kamath, Adams, & Hassan, EMSE 30 Art. 51, 2025 (DOI 10.1007/s10664-024-10555-4)
omitted_baselines.reason_for_omission: Supervised RiskBatch requires historical CI pass/fail labels per commit for training, which frozen v7 warm-up windows (50 merged PRs without CI verdicts) do not contain. Kamath LWD tunes batch sizes across long post-commit Travis CI streams (thousands of builds) rather than 150-PR pre-merge exact-tree bursts.
omitted_baselines.what_would_be_needed: Long-horizon historical CI pass/fail streams (evaluated separately from frozen v7 traces).

omitted_baselines.baseline: Post-merge BIC & LLM fault locators (Fonte ICSE 2023, SemBIC FSE 2025, Marini CoG 2024, Wang 2025)
omitted_baselines.primary_source: An et al. ICSE 2023; Chen et al. FSE 2025; Marini et al. CoG 2024; Wang & Hong arXiv:2511.18854
omitted_baselines.reason_for_omission: These methods require post-merge linear commit histories with SBFL test coverage spectra, multi-version execution traces, or LLM inference over CI crash logs—none of which exist in frozen v7 merge-metadata traces.
omitted_baselines.what_would_be_needed: Executable multi-PR CI failure corpora with stack traces and coverage spectra.

omitted_baselines.baseline: Test-level probabilistic flakiness models (Apple ICSE-SEIP 2020, Meta PFS 2020, FlakeFlagger ICSE 2021, DeFlaker ICSE 2018)
omitted_baselines.primary_source: Kowalczyk et al. ICSE-SEIP 2020; Machalica et al. Meta 2020; Alshammari et al. ICSE 2021; Bell et al. ICSE 2018
omitted_baselines.replacement_in_v8: Queue-level Beta-Binomial flake gate (SSMQ / FIFOBatchRetry controls)
omitted_baselines.reason_for_omission: These models score individual test cases from per-test historical flip rates, test-code features, or differential code coverage, whereas frozen v7 traces represent CI outcomes at whole-job granularity.
omitted_baselines.what_would_be_needed: Per-test longitudinal execution histories and test-suite instrumentation.
